messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Fri 20 Nov
Los40 Music Awards fill Palau Sant Jordi tonight (reported sold out). Sutton's Saturday Tardet usually runs 17:30-23:00 but I couldn't confirm tomorrow's edition.

TODAY · Fri 20 Nov

1. Hop on The Top - The Last Jam - La Terrrazza 2026
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 23:59 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 545 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €23–580
💬 Hip-hop and funk party closing its season at La Terrrazza, the open-air club in Poble Espanyol. Early start, listed on four ticket sites; expect several hundred, a good first stop with friends.
https://ra.co/events/2568058

2. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Fri, hours not stated (runs 13–29 Nov) · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 1,115 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 You hop between neighbourhood bars, one tapa and a drink at each. A night for friends you already have, not for meeting people; how packed it gets this year I couldn't confirm.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

3. La Paloma presents: Quantic Dj set + Chica Acosta + Angela Blackburn
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:30 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 393 interested on RA
💬 Quantic DJs cumbia, soul and funk in La Paloma's old ballroom. A dancing crowd rather than a techno one; RA interest points to a few hundred in a big room.
https://ra.co/events/2571518

4. Tori Kelly + Hillari
🕘 Tonight 19:30 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 announced in @sala apolo's story; tickets still on sale on the venue site this afternoon
💬 US pop-soul singer in Apolo's main hall, pushed in the venue's stories today. No headcount published; the room holds over a thousand and wasn't sold out, so expect busy but not rammed.
https://www.sala-apolo.com/es/evento/tori-kelly-opening-act-hillari20261120-7491

5. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Friday Meetup
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 44 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,221 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Weekly founders and startup drinks, the one tech-crowd social tonight. Mid-sized, likely 40–60 people on the Meetup count; easy to do before a club.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/317223193/

TOMORROW · Sat 21 Nov

1. [Last 100 tickets] Jackies Open Air Daytime - Closing 2026 Season La Terrrazza
🕘 Sat 19:00 → 03:00 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 694 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €28–580
💬 Jackies' season closing at La Terrrazza with Octave One, an RA Pick down to its last tickets. Open-air house from early evening; expect it full, several hundred. Buy ahead.
https://ra.co/events/2534107

2. Monumental Club Indie is Not Dead - Pony Bravo
🕘 Sat 15:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Plaza Monumental de Barcelona
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €16.53
💬 Indie afternoon in the old bullring with Pony Bravo live and DJs, featured in @planesenbarcelona's weekend picks (1,115 likes). No headcount; big open venue, come-and-go with friends, likely a few hundred.
https://dice.fm/event/mxyo9w-monumental-club-indie-is-not-dead-pony-bravo-21st-nov-plaza-monumental-de-barcelona-barcelona-tickets

3. UNLOCKED pres. MVGRI (ANL)
🕘 Sat 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 BASSHAUS
📊 1,179 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 €10
💬 Techno night with the highest interest of anything listed this weekend and a cheap ticket. Basshaus is a mid-sized club, so expect it packed; get there early.
https://ra.co/events/2557201

4. Half Baked x Les Enfants at SEASEACLUB with Margaret Dygas, Tristan da Cunha &…
🕘 Sat 17:00 → 03:00 · 📍 Seaseaclub Barcelona
📊 434 interested on RA · also on DICE, Xceed
💶 €7
💬 The weekend's tardeo: a 17:00 start at Seaseaclub by the beach with minimal and house DJs, running into the night. Also on DICE and Xceed; expect a few hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2537662

5. Saturday Connections Night x Piano Club
🕘 Sat 19:00 → 23:30 · 📍 LOCATION AND TICKETS ON LUMA
📊 82 going on Meetup · group has 15,712 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Digital nomads' Saturday social at a piano bar, an international tech-leaning crowd where you meet new people. Around 80 signed up; tickets and address are on Luma, spots limited.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/317282972/

Scanned: Meetup 428 · RA 81 · DICE 43 · Xceed 24 · Eventbrite 186 · Luma 10 · Instagram 32 posts + 20 stories.
